correctness.rationale: For uniform permutations, moving the largest of the first i entries to position i has exactly i distinct preimages per record-conditioned output, hence a uniform conditional target. Each bubble step removes an inversion and satisfies the convex Monge four-point inequality for ψ(x)=φ(|x|), simultaneously for all nondecreasing convex φ. The maximum of a uniform i-subset has expectation i(n+1)/(i+1). Conditional prefix symmetry then gives the exact footrule mean deficit −i(2i−1)/(3n), indicator covariance −(2i−1)/(3n), total-record covariance −(n²−1)/(3n), and the squared-displacement formula. Independently enumerated every permutation n=2..7 and checked 21 (n,i) rational regressions for footrule and squared cost. The i-to-one map and convex inequality, not finite enumeration, prove all n.
